Two separate road accidents kill seven in India

Two separate road accidents in India have resulted in the deaths of seven young men. In Palwal, a collision between a car and a motorcycle claimed the life of an NHAI employee. In Balrampur, a head-on collision between two motorcycles killed five friends, leaving two others seriously injured. Debris including broken helmets and a dead goat were found at the Balrampur accident site.
